name: layout
note: Two position commands with clear hypotheses. 3D60 walks the 30 player roster slots and, for every unit whose HP is non-zero and which is not the protagonist's machine, writes a grid position, filling each row before starting the next — a formation. Four ordinary units are deployed scattered, so the roster diff shows whether they end up in rows. 3D56 opens window 0x23 and draws a rectangle whose two corners are packed as decimal (value/10, value%10); the original (186, 212, 60) gives corners (18,6) and (21,2), and the camera is placed over that area so a highlighted rectangle, if drawn, is in frame. The third word is not read by the resident code.

deployments.note: マナミ — protagonist, should be skipped by 3D60

commands.note: camera over the area 3D56 is about to highlight (18..21, 2..6)
